name: Zombie Tycoon
desc:
In a world where a virus has turned most people into zombies, everyone is rushing to find the antidote. Will you be the first to save humanity?

💵 Earn money by trying to save the world
🧪 Perform experiments to test your antidote
🕹️ Explore the map with your friends. Remember to watch out for zombies
🚁 Fly in the helicopter at the end to rebirth and get a money multiplier

💾 This game has autosave
